tested_scope: 20 cells: 5 witness compositions x 4 rollback/ref-recreation scenarios
result: A mutable named ref plus an immutable object SHA and any expected digest derived only from rollback-local repository state still admits a self-consistent stale ABA after full rollback. Hash/object checks improve integrity and partial-mismatch detection, but do not supply freshness when every discoverability/freshness input can revert together. Deterministic object-SHA derivation changes this only when the derivation identity is already nonrollback and statelessly available; that identity is itself the missing witness.
paired_history_proof: A never-advanced g1 history and a history that advanced to g2 then restored every repository-visible handle/input to the exact g1 view are observationally identical to a stateless repository-only algorithm. Accepting g1 for useful progress in the first also accepts stale g1 in the second; refusing for freshness safety also refuses in the first.
